newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank in Shanghai opens global forex trading.
newsitem.headline: China bank in Shanghai opens global forex trading.

text.p: The Shanghai branch of China's state-run Communications Bank will extend foreign exchange trading hours so individual investors can trade overnight on the London and New York markets, Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
The move was a first in Chinese banking history, the newspaper said, adding that the bank opened foreign exchange trading to individuals earlier this year.

Night trading will operate from 6-10 p.m. (1000-0230 GMT) Monday to Friday, it said, with 6-8 p.m. (1000-1200 GMT) trading on the London market and 8-10 p.m. (0000-0200 GMT) trading on the New York market.
